scope.summary: BkGui integration test per Section 13.27 GUI clauses: a no-context model drives a complete channel-edit -> capture -> verify loop through Argus alone — discover the pane from the accesskit tree, set a breast-volume channel to an over-range value by author_id, capture the viewport, and verify both control state and rendered change without any GUI-shell manual interaction.
acceptance_criteria: The test starts from zero UI knowledge: enumerate the accesskit tree, locate the BodyKit tab and the breast volume slider purely by author_id conventions documented in the UserManual chapter.

It sets the slider to a designed over-range value, confirms the CRDT edit landed (get_body shows the new channel value), captures the viewport, and verifies the capture differs from the baseline (image hash delta).
The whole flow runs headless in CI with no foreground window, no focus steal, and a clean console error scan (quiet-mode compliance).
Failure output includes the accesskit tree snapshot and the last capture so a no-context model can diagnose without re-running.
The flow is documented as the reference Argus recipe in the UserManual BodyKit chapter (MT-651 cross-link).
scope.risk_if_missed: The GUI claims model-operability without proof; the first real agent session discovers unreachable controls or unstable ids mid-production, and the HBR-VIS/INT posture for BodyKit is built on an untested assumption.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
